nodes.label: Limit Order Book Price Clearing Mechanism
nodes.community_name: Paper Model, Order Book & Work Plan
nodes.norm_label: limit order book price clearing mechanism
nodes.rationale: Single global order book judged a good first approximation of the many Bitcoin exchanges; buy orders sorted descending by limit, sells ascending, ties by issue time; transaction price = midpoint of limits, or min/max with current price for market orders. More realistic than daily aggregate clearing but alone yields poor fat tails with only Random traders.

nodes.label: Aggregate Imbalance Price Mechanism (dashboard/simulation.py)
nodes.community_name: Paper Model, Order Book & Work Plan
nodes.rationale: Top-down: every trader trades with an infinite-counterparty market; next price = prezzo x (1 + impatto x squilibrio + shock_notizia + rumore_casuale). Pragmatic, fast simplification chosen as trade-off of paper fidelity vs implementation time/risk; the 'versione leggera' cited in the guide.
